executiveSummary: Iteration 000002 is fully compliant after two targeted fixes: (1) INFER_DELAY_SECONDS is now read from an env var in tasks.py; (2) README markdown bold formatting was removed so test assertions pass. All 8 FRs and 8 USs comply. 51 gateway + 26 worker tests green.

GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL and INTERNAL_CALLBACK_SECRET in gateway/.env.example are planned for later phases; not yet implemented.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: Iteration fully compliant. Phase 3 should introduce configurable asset URL and implement the remaining env vars (GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL, INTERNAL_CALLBACK_SECRET).
